programme.title: Vivre sous zéro ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: S15 E06 — Gelé jusqu'à l'os Au coeur de l'hiver, les températures sont glaciales; Sue Aikens doit reconstituer ses ressources à Chena pour survivre; Jessie apprend à récolter de la nourriture dans son nouvel environnement; Ricko doit s'assurer que son camp reste habitable.

programme.title: Exil vers le Nord ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: S01 E03 Avec l'aide d'un ami, Margot termine son chalet avant l'arrivée de l'hiver. Billy se lance dans un ambitieux projet de construction de pont. Matty fait appel à un renfort. Emilie et Gilbert entreprennent un périple éprouvant dans la forêt.

programme.title: Alone: les survivants
programme.desc: S08 E10 Des participants réfléchissent à de nouvelles stratégies pour trouver de quoi manger. Compte tenu de la difficulté à se procurer de la nourriture à ce stade avancé de la compétition, la menace d'être éliminé est plus réelle que jamais.

programme.title: Le vet de Bondi en cavale
programme.desc: S03 E03 Chris découvre l'une des plus grandes merveilles naturelles du monde. Il se rend dans la capitale irlandaise de la musique, fait un tour de rivière sauvage aux îles Fidji, sent la terre bouger à Las Vegas et teste une étonnante destination vacances.

programme.title: Bienvenue chez nous ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: Géraldine et Hubert En 2006, Géraldine se lance dans un projet de tourisme rural; elle ouvre trois chambres d'hôtes et développe une activité de ferme pédagogique dans la ferme vieille de plus de 200 ans appartenant à la famille d'Hubert, son mari.

programme.title: Deux tapons au Japon ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Tokyo Benoît et Jean-Michel commencent leur voyage en grand à Tokyo ; ils découvrent une ville de grands écrans lumineux, de foule dense, de mode éclectique et de cafés avec robots serveurs ; ils explorent différents quartiers pour en saisir l'essence.

programme.title: Deux tapons au Japon ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Nagoya Jean-Michel et Benoît découvrent Nagoya, quatrième plus grande ville du Japon ; ville industrielle détruite pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, elle est un c?ur économique du pays ; boudée par les touristes, ils partent explorer ses attraits cachés.

programme.title: Seuls face à l'Alaska ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: S03 E02 — Les ténèbres Au Nouveau-Mexique, Kyle et son fils Ben sauvent un troupeau de bisons à l'approche d'une tempête; à Blue Ridge Mountains en Caroline du Nord, Eustace et son ami Preston tentent de stopper un glissement de terrain qui met en péril une route rurale.

programme.title: Top 10 météo ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: S02 E05 — Inventions météo Des boules de foudre qui dansent à l'horizon; des animaux qui tombent du ciel; des météores de glace qui détruisent des maisons; malgré nos outils modernes et les avancées technologiques, certains phénomènes météorologiques restent inexpliqués.

programme.title: Top 10 météo ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: S02 E02 — Phénomènes météo les plus étranges La météo comporte plus d'ingrédients qu'un buffet à volonté. Dame Nature nous sert parfois un festin météorologique qui étonne même les météorologues les plus chevronnés. Voici les 10 phénomènes météorologiques les plus étranges de la planète.

programme.desc: S03 E13 — La Paz Geneviève et Guillaume visitent La Paz en Bolivie, la capitale administrative la plus haute du monde ; ils ont 24 heures pour découvrir la ville avec 100 $ ou 1 000 $.

programme.title: Avec ou sans cash
programme.desc: S05 E01 — Nice Geneviève et Guillaume se laissent charmer par la ville de Nice, en France ; au menu pour la personne qui aura 1500 $ : zodiac sur les eaux azur et atelier de parfums ; pour le petit budget : exploration du marché Saleya en compagnie d'un grand chef.

programme.title: Avec ou sans cash
programme.desc: S05 E02 — San Sebastiàn Guillaume et Geneviève visitent la ville de San Sebastián en Espagne ; le riche découvre la plage de surf, un parc d'attractions rétro et la pelote basque ; le modeste se rend dans une cidrerie, fait un tour de bateau et goûte aux pintxos.

programme.title: Ice Vikings: pêche extrême
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Un jour, une panne Nouveau jour, nouvelle panne ; les problèmes continuent avec les bombardiers de Trevor et Chris ; entre-temps, Justin et Mike se dirigent vers l'île Hecla, où ils espèrent que les prises seront meilleures que celles qu'ils ont eues jusqu'à présent.

programme.title: Ice Vikings: pêche extrême
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Le stress monte Le bombardier de Richard et Mike est tombé en panne ; lorsqu'ils arrivent enfin sur la glace, ils se rendent compte que les poissons ne sont pas au rendez-vous ; les Kristjanson sont sous pression à cause d'un vieux problème avec leur bombardier.

programme.title: Ice Vikings: pêche extrême
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Tel père, tel fils Trevor décide d'acheter son propre fourgon et va demander conseil à son père ; Chris profite du sien et envisage de clore la saison plus tôt que prévu ; Gene et Candace préparent leurs poissons avant d'aller les vendre au marché.

programme.title: Exil vers le Nord
programme.desc: S01 E03 Avec l'aide d'un ami, Margot termine son chalet avant l'arrivée de l'hiver. Billy se lance dans un ambitieux projet de construction de pont. Matty fait appel à un renfort. Emilie et Gilbert entreprennent un périple éprouvant dans la forêt.

programme.title: Chasse à l'homme: marécage
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Scène de crime et fugitif dangereux L'équipe de pistage arrive sur la scène de crime : 72 heures pour traquer le fugitif; ils devront utiliser tout ce qu'ils ont appris lors du bootcamp; mais ça ne s'annonce pas si facile; rapidement, les esprits s'échauffent dans l'équipe.

programme.title: Chasse à l'homme: marécage
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Fausse piste et retour à zéro Dur retour à zéro pour l'équipe de pistage : le temps file et la tension monte; sur la scène de crime, des traces se sont effacées, des indices se sont envolés; mauvaises communications, compétition pour le leadership et fatigue mènent au conflit.

programme.title: Alone: les survivants
programme.desc: S08 E11 Les trois participants toujours en lice s'accrochent pour remporter le prix de 500 000$. Tandis que certains continuent de se battre mentalement pour rester dans la compétition, un nouveau prédateur vient menacer la survie d'un des participants.

programme.title: Sanctum
programme.desc: Tandis qu'ils explorent une grotte souterraine dans le sud Pacifique, un plongeur chevronné et son équipe se retrouvent piégés dans un labyrinthe.

programme.title: Van aventure
programme.desc: S01 E07 — Poisson Blanc Après plusieurs semaines sur la route, Dominic reçoit la visite de sa blonde Annie et de leur fils Thomas; l'adolescent est plutôt réfractaire aux joies du plein air, mais le parc du Poisson Blanc a de quoi convaincre les publics les plus difficiles.

programme.title: Van aventure
programme.desc: S01 E08 — Malbaie Passionné de course à pied, Dominic se rend à La Malbaie pour participer à l'Ultra-Trail Harricana, une course dans des sentiers denses; il profite de son séjour pour marcher les sentiers du Parc national des Hautes-Gorges-de-la-Rivière-Malbaie.

programme.title: The Game Catchers

programme.title: Fia's Fairies
programme.desc: S2 — Double Booked The fairies are double-booked! With chicks and hedgehogs to babysit, they team up to help - and learn the importance of checking plans with friends and family.

programme.title: Puffin Rock As Gaeilge
programme.desc: S1 E4 — An Sliogán Lonrach Oona and Baba go to watch the seagulls. Baba finds a beautiful shiny shell, but the shell attracts the attention of the seagulls, which causes trouble for Oona.

programme.title: Puffin Rock As Gaeilge
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Flynne Chairdiúil Mossy is missing and Oona becomes increasingly worried about where her friend could be. In trying to find him, she is offered help from a very unlikely source: Flynne the sly fox.

programme.title: Puffin Rock As Gaeilge
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Leaba Chleiteach Oona and Baba go in search of soft bedding for Puffins' burrow.

programme.title: Silly Sundays
programme.desc: S1 E48 — Balloon Rocket Hugo and Sonia learn the value of observation when their rocket experiment doesn't turn out as they'd hoped.

programme.title: Silly Sundays
programme.desc: S1 E49 — Dad's Present When Dad's present does not go to plan, Sonia and Hugo learn that their time together is a gift in itself.

programme.title: Bellie and Whizz `Minding Me'
programme.desc: S1 E11 — Grumpy Everybody feels grumpy sometimes, especially Whizz when she doesn't get enough sleep. There's only one thing to do, the Sunshine Spread.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: S2 E11 — Wild Cat Munchkin Munchkin reinvents himself as a 'cool cat' with Flix's help, but his bold new image quickly leads to unexpected trouble.

programme.title: Lex and Plu Space Taxi Drivers
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Bent Out of Tape A fox, Lex, and his raccoon friend, Plu, have adventures whilst driving their self-built space taxi. Their friends, Trish the fox, Greg the blue-footed booby, and a mushroom, Crispy, join their adventures.

programme.title: MaeBee
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Mae, Bee and the Moss Troll Eager to impress her dad, Mae sells an umbrella promised to another customer. When things erupt into troll-sized chaos, Mae, proving her troll strength, helps reveal the real problem.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: S1 E7 — Statue of Liberty, USA Grandmaster Glitch collapses the Statue of Liberty right into the path of a passing ferry, which causes a lot of inconvenience.

programme.title: Kiva Can Do

programme.title: Baile na Samhlaíochta
programme.desc: S1 E77 — Episode 77 Sonia, Hugo, and Mel create full-of-heart memories with Mum, Dad, and Granny on those playful days spent with family and friends.

programme.title: Hey Fuzzy Yellow
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Beach Vacuum Wheel While Fuzzy Yellow and friends play on the beach, the pesky Caviar litters everywhere. Moon invents a solution to clean up the mess.

programme.title: Hey Fuzzy Yellow
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Pineapple Dream Tool Fuzzy Yellow wants to tell all the friends about an amazing dream from last night, but now Fuzzy Yellow can't remember it.

programme.title: Playtime Towers

programme.title: Body Brothers

programme.title: Tír na nÓg

programme.desc: S29 — Making It Up as You Go Along! A newbie Derbyshire developer admits he's winging it! In Bournemouth, Martin is gobsmacked by the building he's in. Jacqui is in a Norfolk village called Little Snoring, but there's no time for her to have a nap with a property to see.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: S27 E32 — Norfolk and Suffolk Borders Briony May Williams searches the Norfolk and Suffolk countryside for a home that's just right for a discerning couple plus their three dogs and a fleet of wheels.

programme.title: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: S9 E4 — River Tees, County Durham - Trout Paul and Bob travel to the upper Tees, where Bob shares some very special childhood memories. They are joined by an old friend who tells them spooky tales about the river.

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: S2 E3 — Quantum Arms Race Through exclusive interviews with world-class experts in quantum technologies, Hannah Fry looks at the international quantum arms race between the US and China.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

programme.title: Political Thinking with Nick Robinson ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: S3 Nick Robinson has a conversation with, not an interrogation of, the people who shape our political thinking about what shaped theirs.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: S2 E15 — Episode 15 Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: S3 E5 — Episode 5 Four colleagues from Colchester Zoo, Lizzie, Kez, Mo and Sue, take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category.

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: S1 E14 — Neath Sean Fletcher explores the annual Neath food festival and finds out whether traditional or exotic Welsh cakes are more popular among the visitors. Food journalist Leyla Kazim reveals secrets of tomato growing on a large and small scale, while farmer Jim Smith gets stuck into making marmalade. Ryan Hand tries an experiment to find out whether there is such a thing as 'brain food'.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Thurso to Orkney From Britain's northernmost station at Thurso in Caithness, Michael Portillo heads for the ferry port of Scrabster to cross the Pentland Firth to the Orkney Islands. Passing the Old Man of Hoy, Michael takes in stunning views of the Orkney archipelago and the rugged coastlines of its 70 islands. Michael reaches land at Stromness on the largest of the islands, Mainland, and heads for Kirkwall, its most historic town.

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: S1 E5 — The Gamble Emilia Jayne hunts for cuttlefish in the world's busiest shipping lane. Cargo ships have right of way here, but lucrative cuttlefish swim in these grounds too. Margaret of Ladram is Brixham's most successful trawler. This week, skipper Adam Cowan Dickie is gambling, he's leaving his home waters of the English Channel behind and steaming 20 hours to the Bristol Channel.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: S28 E15 — Coughton Court Michael Aspel and the team head for Coughton Court in Warwickshire. Amongst the items under scrutiny are original designs from one of Britain's leading graphic artists of the 20th century, a bizarre Japanese depiction of skeletons dancing, and a lost masterpiece valued at £60,000.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Somerset 11 Paul Martin and the team are at the Fleet Air Arm Museum situated on HMS Heron, the naval aviation base in Yeovilton, Somerset. Paul is joined by experts Charlie Ross and Thomas Plant, and together they pick out a selection of interesting antiques to be sold at a local auction.

programme.title: House of Games ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: S10 E40 — Week 8: Friday Every day this week, celebrity contestants Jake Bhardwaj, Sue Cleaver, Rachel Parris and Rav Wilding take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quick-fire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player?

programme.title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: S24 E40 — Episode 40 Ellie Taylor is on hand with more Strictly exclusives and behind-the-scenes action from the Tower Ballroom. Also, she's joined by a brand-new all-star panel to break down the upcoming performances ahead of the weekend's Blackpool Extravaganza.

programme.title: Newsnight ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: Featuring extensive coverage of the day's top national and international news stories, along with explanations about the context and potential aftereffects.

programme.title: Naturewatch ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Episode 3 Chris Packham is joined by Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin for a lively, curiosity-fuelled exploration of Britain's wildlife, tackling the fascinating, the unexpected and the downright bizarre.

programme.title: Gardeners' World ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: Winter Specials:Episode 1 At Longmeadow, Monty has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses, while Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment.

programme.title: Boxing ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: Lauren Price v Michaela Kotaskova Having made history to become Wales's first female boxing world champion and cementing herself among the sport's elite, Lauren Price returns to home soil to defend her unified world welterwight titles against Michaela Kotaskova. Catrin Heledd and the team present live coverage from the Cardiff International Arena.

programme.title: The Dead Don't Hurt
programme.desc: When the man she loves, Holger Olsen, goes off to fight in the Civil War, Vivienne Le Coudy must fend for herself in a place controlled by a corrupt mayor and his unscrupulous business partner.

programme.title: Match of the Day Wales Live
programme.desc: Norway v Wales 14.11 Norway v Wales (Kick-off 5.00pm). All the action from both teams' fifth and penultimate UEFA Nations League Group A4 match, held at Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo. Both teams have just one win and three defeats to their name in the group, with Wales' victory coming in last month's reverse fixture at Cardiff City Stadium. Oscar Bobb opened the scoring for the Norwegians on that occasion, but Craig Bellamy's men fought back with strikes from Dan James and Neco Williams.

programme.title: Live International Football ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: Northern Ireland v Ukraine Northern Ireland v Ukraine (Kick-off 7.45pm). All the action from both teams' penultimate UEFA Nations League Group B2 match, held at Windsor Park. Northern Ireland went into this round of fixtures on top of the table with two wins and two draws, with their most convincing display coming against the Ukrainians in Slovakia. They prevailed 3-0 in that contest thanks to a brace by Ciaron Brown and a strike from Isaac Price, and another victory would secure them a place in at least the promotion play-offs.

programme.title: 40 Hits of 1975 at the BBC
programme.desc: Take a musical trip back in time to 50 years ago, with 40 essential hits from 1975 plucked from the BBC's archives. The punk explosion was two years away and disco was only just starting to surface, but these 12 months were still packed with classic songs that remain staples to this day. Key moments include Abba in Blackpool on Seaside Special and Bay City Rollers riding the wave of Rollermania, as well as debut hits from key artists who were pioneers in their individual genres, including Bob Marley, Supertramp and Kraftwerk.

programme.title: Godland
programme.desc: Period drama starring Elliott Crosset Hove and Ingvar Sigurdsson. In the late 19th century, Danish Lutheran missionary Lucas is sent to a remote community in Iceland, where he is to build and establish a church. With the reluctant help of his gruff guide, Ragnar, Lucas weathers the challenges of the harsh rural climate, but the demands of his mission begin to take their toll.

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: S2 E6 The tragic events of the party send shockwaves through the Phelans. As dangerous secrets threaten to come to light, Michael is forced to make a difficult confession to Diana. Meanwhile, unseen dangers close in, and it becomes clear no-one is safe.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: S4 E2 Sam Ryder, Jeff Stelling and Ella Eyre, accompanied by friends or relatives, and Princess and Junior Andre continue their epic 7,500km race. The second leg takes the teams across the heart of Borneo to a modern metropolis on its eastern coast and their second checkpoint.

programme.title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
programme.desc: S2 E2 — Ade Adepitan Anita strikes up an in-depth conversation with Paralympian and broadcaster Ade Adepitan, discovering what makes Christmas special for him and how it's been a marker for memorable moments in his career, family life and faith.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: S2026 — Co Antrim Dairy Charlotte Smith and Adam Henson explore how dairy farmers across Co Antrim, one of Northern Ireland's most productive dairy regions, are turning to tech and innovative business models to build a more resilient future. Adam also introduces this year's BBC Food and Farming Awards Countryfile Young Countryside Champion nominees.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: S2026 E22 Dougie Vipond visits Castlemilk on the southern edge of Glasgow to explores a local nature reserve that has transformed the location from perceived no-go zone to a thriving green place. Arlene Stuart heads to an Aberdeenshire shoemakers' workshop that shut over 80 years ago to meet the locals carefully conserving the shop's contents, while Anne Lundon is on the Black Isle finding out about a charity funded by Children in Need providing bereavement support across the Highlands.

programme.title: Sian Eleri's BBC Children in Need Road Trip
programme.desc: Radio 1 presenter Sian Eleri takes on an almighty challenge when BBC Children In Need's Pudsey bear sends her on a Wales-wide road trip. Her mission is to find six Children In Need funded projects across Wales that support the development and well-being of young people.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: S2025 — 30/11/2025 Andi Oliver takes a classic British dessert and transforms it into a savoury number with her three cheese and leek bread and butter pudding. She then grills slices of it with a rarebit sauce on top, serving it with a leek and spinach veloute. Niklas Ekstedt brings the taste of Sweden to the studio with the iconic Jansson's temptation, which he serves alongside a deliciously fatty pork chop. Sabrina Ghayour serves up three tasty treats that are perfect for sharing: lamb barberry and pine nut koftas, pomegranate-glazed aubergines, and muhammara dip.Rick Stein has a dish inspired by his travels, while Paul A Young makes maraschino cherry and almond truffles. And Mel C is in the hot seat to face either her food heaven, roast lamb, or her food hell, okra.Meanwhile, Rick Stein has a peek behind the scenes at how the filming of his shows doesn't always go to plan, and Clive Myrie gets a taste of Caribbean honey.

programme.title: Best Bakes Ever
programme.desc: S1 E10 In light of Britain's baking obsession, actress and cake expert Jane Asher presents a selection of recipes from television chefs, including James Martin, Mary Berry, Paul Hollywood, the Hairy Bikers, Raymond Blanc, Nigella Lawson, Tom Kerridge, Lorraine Pascale and Rachel Khoo.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Unsung Heroes (Shortened Version) The food writer prepares simple, tasty meals from ingredients that are often overlooked, including a lentil and chard stew.

programme.title: Jane Eyre
programme.desc: Period drama based on Charlotte Brontë's classic novel, starring Orson Welles and Joan Fontaine. Following an austere orphanage upbringing, a shy young woman becomes a governess in a vast Yorkshire mansion where the master of the house, Rochester, appears troubled by some inner torment.

programme.title: Spellbound
programme.desc: Psychological thriller starring Ingrid Bergman and Gregory Peck. Dedicated psychiatrist Constance Peterson amazes everyone, including herself, by falling in love with a man she believes to be a paranoid impostor and who may even be guilty of murder.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: S14 E51 — Compilation 57 A collection of interesting finds from the show, with visits to Margam Country Park in south Wales, Highcliffe Castle in Dorset and Powderham Castle in Devon. Experts including Catherine Southon, Adam Partridge, Philip Serrell, Will Axon, Christina Trevanion and Mark Stacey assess items ranging from a South African Krugerrand coin to a rare walnut-shaped Japanese flintlock. Presenter Paul Martin also takes a look at the treasures and lavish interiors at Firle Place in East Sussex.

programme.title: Golf: Tour Championship Highlights
programme.desc: 2026 Action from the DP World Tour season-ending event, which came from Jumeirah Golf Estates in Dubai the United Arab Emirates. England's Matt Fitzpatrick won this tournament for a record-equalling third time last year, beating 2024 champion Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland, who has also claimed this title on three occasions, in a play-off.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: S4 E3 Sam Ryder, Jeff Stelling, Ella Eyre and Princess and Junior Andre continue their 7,500km race. The third leg sees the teams leave behind the ancient jungles of Borneo to reach the island of Sulawesi, an Indonesian wonderland that lies far from the tourist trail. But with the end of Ramadan fast approaching, the teams must negotiate the crowds heading home for Eid al-Fitr.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: S6 E8 As the days grow longer, the MacDonalds round up their pregnant Highland cattle on the tiny island of Vallay, off North Uist, for a pre-natal check up and vitamin boost. In the Cairngorms, Jenni's new alpaca arena is finally finished, which means her menagerie of alpacas, donkeys and goats must be moved to their new home. Nikki and Ollie speculate to accumulate in Moray, splashing out on a new honesty shack.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: S3 E7 — Patisserie The actress learns about the art of patisserie in Paris, which is home to more award-winning pastry chefs than anywhere else in the world, sampling the Paris-Brest, a rum baba, the macaron, a mango cake and a dahlia.

programme.title: Ireland with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: S1 E1 Part one of two. Simon explores the history of both the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland and examines the rich culture and troubled past of the island. Simon arrives by ferry in Co Wexford and travels along the coast, joining the thousands who try to climb the sacred mountain of Croagh Patrick. He crosses the border to visit Crom Castle and Londonderry, before journeying to the northernmost point at Malin Head.

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: S9 E4 — River Tees, Co Durham - Trout Bob and Paul Bob head to Co Durham to fish for a rare species of wild brown trout in the River Tees. They navigate the area through the lens of a six-year-old Bob as he takes Paul on a trip along the landscapes of his youth and reminisces about the fishing trips he used to go on with his. Later, their old friend Reece Shearsmith joins them for dinner, and he has some particularly spooky local tales to tell them about the Tees.

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Into the Fourth Quarter As Bill Murray's 75th birthday approaches, his brother Joel arrives to inject some family rivalry into the trip. Comedian Joanne McNally joins in the fun with her first-ever attempt at golf, while a bouncing boat trip to the Cliffs of Moher brings more unexpected encounters. Then friends and familiar faces gather to celebrate a milestone birthday - and a Bill reflects on what the future holds.

programme.title: Fontaines DC at Later… with Jools Holland
programme.desc: S69 E6 — Fontaines D.C Jools presents a special edition featuring Fontaines DC, with the Irish rock band taking to the stage at Alexandra Palace Theatre in north London for an intimate performance. They play songs from latest album Dopamine Chamber as well as tracks from their back catalogue.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: Oscar-winning thriller starring Jeremy Renner. A US Army bomb-disposal team working out the last 38 days of their tour in Iraq are joined by Staff Sgt William James, whose unorthodox methods make him initially unpopular with his colleagues.

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: S4 E3 — The Machete Raid A knife attack in Inverness leads police to a volatile suspect and a house packed with blades, from samurai swords and machetes to zombie knives. Released on bail while police await DNA results, the man is soon wanted over another violent attack. On the Isle of Skye, rescuers race to find a climber missing for three days in the mountains, while an American tourist has an unusual concern after a crash near Fort William.

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: 12/11/2026 Fiona Bruce hosts the topical debate, with a panel of politicians and other guests facing questions from the audience in Exeter.

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: S1 E1 Comic spy thriller set in 1980s East Berlin. MI6 officer Martha Schmitt yearns for a more serious assignment while posing as the lover of a British diplomat. She is forced to work with a CIA officer who ruined a previous mission. But a feared Stasi operative has been observing Martha, and an unlikely love triangle begins to develop. Starring Ann Skelly and Rory Kinnear.

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: S1 E2 Martha investigates Hermann's murder with Kurt, which requires them to infiltrate a strange sausage factory. A sceptical Friedrich dispatches two of his inept officers to look into the case, while a terrified and confused Greta is running out of options for refuge.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: S75 — Children in Need 2026 Christina Trevanion presents as Radio 2's OJ Borg and Melvin Odoom compete against BBC Asian Network's Nikita Kanda and Radio 1's Maia Beth to raise money for Children in Need under the guidance of Izzie Balmer and Nick Hall. A brass pipe sparks a conversation about foreign languages for OJ and Melvin on the red team while Nikita and Maia in blue take a shine to a tatty foot stool.

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Seasonal Seas The wildlife in the seasonal seas in the temperate bands between the freezing poles and the warm tropics, where changing conditions over the course of the year push animals to be resourceful and adaptable. In the winter, storms at sea whip up immense waves that can travel for thousands of miles building to 30 metres height, while in the summer, temperatures can rise by 50 degrees Celsius in a matter of weeks.

programme.title: See Hear
programme.desc: S45 E3 — The Future of Deaf Education Marios Costi presents an exploration of the history and future of deaf education, from the fight for sign language in schools to the need for better access, representation and support for deaf children.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: 16/11/2026 A round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: 16/11/2026 The latest stories from Westminster and beyond.

programme.desc: S2 E11 Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: S3 E1 Quiz show hosted by Ross Kemp in which contestants compete for cash by crossing a bridge made up of stepping stones, each of which has a different option. Friends Jacqui, Nigel, Phil and Jane must try to get from A to B by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies in order to cross the studio floor safely, or risk falling off the bridge and out of the game.

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: S1 E10 — York Sean Fletcher and Edith Bowman go in search of tips and treats at the York Food Festival, including homemade hummus and the many surprising varieties of the English apple. Onkar Singh Purewal is on the hunt for healthy food the whole family will eat, Ryan Hand gets to grips with Japanese cuisine, and chef Julie Lin reveals some affordable seafood.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Inverness to the Cairngorms Michael Portillo crosses the Culloden Viaduct aboard the Caledonian Sleeper to arrive bright and early in Inverness, from where he heads north on a magnificent scenic adventure to the Orkney archipelago. On boggy moorland overlooking the Moray Firth near Inverness, Michael explores the battlefield at Culloden, where Bonnie Prince Charlie's Jacobite army fought British Government troops in 1746.

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: S1 E1 — The Rookie Documentary charting the contrasting fortunes of British fishing boats over the course of one brutal week. Ocean Pride targets shipwrecks off Cornwall in pursuit of pollack, and Margaret of Ladram hunts for lucrative Dover sole in the English Channel. Meanwhile, off the Yorkshire coast, crabber Tydus welcomes a greenhorn to the crew.

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: S28 E10 — Rochdale Michael Aspel and the team visit Rochdale's town hall, where objects brought in for scrutiny include a gold pencil given as a gift by George IV, paintbrushes used by Salford-born artist LS Lowry and the diaries of a British hangman.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: S15 E2 — Althorp Extended Christina Trevanion and Will Axon value items brought to Althorp House in Northamptonshire, where Christina is drawn to a 1950s toy pedal car and Will finds a Mouseman tray. Plus, Paul Martin discovers that the Grand Union was the canal equivalent of the M1.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: S10 E36 — Week 8: Monday Michael Sheen is joined by Jake Bhardwaj, Sue Cleaver, Rachel Parris and Rav Wilding, who compete in a series of fun trivia-based games.

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: S24 E36 — 16/11/2026 Ellie Taylor digs into all the weekend's action with her all-star panel. Plus, the latest couple to be eliminated from the competition will be on the sofa for a chat about their time on Strictly.

programme.title: Global Eye
programme.desc: Who Owns Libya's Future? Tim Whewell reports from eastern Libya, where a vast reconstruction programme led by the Haftar family is transforming cities and reshaping the country's political future. Plus, the programme catches up with Sudanese boy Zaher, whose life was changed by war a year ago when a drone strike left him severely injured.

programme.title: Live International Football ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: Switzerland v Scotland 16.11 Switzerland v Scotland (Kick-off 7.45pm). Coverage of both teams' concluding match in Group B1 of the UEFA Nations League, held at Berit Sitterstadion in St Gallen. Switzerland claimed an impressive 3-0 win in September's reverse fixture at Hampden Park thanks to goals by Ricardo Rodriguez, Nico Elvedi and Zeki Amdouni. However, Scotland are unbeaten away from home in the group, having drawn 0-0 in Slovenia and won 2-0 at North Macedonia.

programme.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
programme.desc: S2 E1 Return of the documentary following officers from the Police Service of Northern Ireland as they patrol the streets of Belfast. Dave and Owen stop a suspected drug dealer and find a wad of cash and cocaine, while officers breaking up a street brawl face a torrent of abuse from one of the men involved, and Dennis and Chris of the auto-crime team notice a car being driven erratically round a bend.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: 16/11/2026 Insights and global interviews on the news stories of the day, presented by Victoria Derbyshire.

programme.title: The Model Trap: Exposing Jeffrey Epstein's Network
programme.desc: BBC Eye reveals new evidence showing how scouts, agencies and powerful fashion figures helped Jeffrey Epstein gain access to young women after his conviction for sex offences.

programme.title: Harriet
programme.desc: Historical drama starring Cynthia Erivo and Janelle Monáe. Maryland in the 1840s: born into slavery, Araminta Ross flees her owner before he can sell her on, and is chased for a hundred miles before arriving in Philadelphia. Adopting the name of Harriet Tubman, she goes on to be a pioneering activist, vociferous abolitionist and fearless freedom fighter who returns to the South to free slaves on the secret Underground Railroad.

programme.desc: S45 E3 — The Future of Deaf Education Marios Costi presents an exploration of the history and future of deaf education, from the fight for sign language in schools to the need for better access, representation and support for deaf children.

Adam also introduces this year's BBC Food and Farming Awards Countryfile Young Countryside Champion nominees.

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
programme.desc: S1 E2 Marco Pierre White chases Michelin stars, Gordon Ramsay breaks away to build his own name, and Heston Blumenthal rewrites the rules as success brings fame and new pressures. Gordon recounts the story of the stealing of his restaurant's reservation book, revealing just how bitter the situation became, while Marcus Wareing, Gordon's first employee, recalls the early days of Gordon's kitchen and the fierce ambition driving it.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: S75 — Ardingly 18 In West Sussex, two teams fly around the stalls aided by Caroline Hawley and Thomas Forrester, while Natasha Raskin Sharp jets off to see a collection of airline memorabilia.

programme.title: Clive Myrie's Caribbean Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Havana - Cuba In Cuba's capital, Clive takes on a potential Olympic champion at one of Havana's legendary boxing gyms. He visits a car mechanic to get under the hood of a classic Chevy and discovers why most cars in Cuba are pre-1959 models. Clive also follows in the footsteps of the Buena Vista Social Club to find out how Cuban rhythms conquered the world.

programme.title: Only Connect
programme.desc: S22 E9 — Culture Club v Ad Astra Victoria Coren Mitchell host the quiz as first-round losers the Culture Club and Ad Astra return to compete for a place in the next round, with the loser being knocked out. The teams must use patience, lateral thinking and sheer inspiration to make connections between four things that may appear at first not to be linked, with one set of clues asking what connects fore, dog, anti, and woebe.

programme.title: See Hear
programme.desc: S45 E14 — Deaf Parenting Exploring deaf parenting, sharing family stories, practical advice and the challenges of raising children, from the early years to adulthood. Tammy Broskom presents.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: S3 E2 Family members Suraj, Nisha, Tina and Rob compete for money by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp.

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: S1 E11 — Ploughing Sean Fletcher and Edith Bowman visit the National Ploughing Championships in Derbyshire on a food adventure, where they discover the story behind the Bakewell tart and are let loose on tractors. Farmer Meinir Howells reveals the secrets of one of the UK's oldest ice-cream parlours, Ryan Hand finds out the superpowers of seeds, and farmer Jim Smith learns the art of pickling.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: S1 E7 — Cullen to Cawdor Michael Portillo travels by train north from Inverness to the Orkney Islands. Beginning on the Moray Firth, Michael admires the Cullen Viaduct then enjoys a bowl of Cullen skink at a family-run fishmonger of 150 years' standing. In the factory smokery, he learns from the owner how the famous soup acquires its distinctive taste.

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: S1 E2 — The Price Crash Off the coast of Yorkshire Siwrengale is heading out for the beginning of the North Sea whelk season. Skipper Darren Warters is on the hunt with sons Regan and Lewis. But winter storms have badly damaged their pots - and miles of rope must be untangled before they can begin fishing in earnest. Reliance III is south east of Shetland, where skipper John Clarke is hunting for whiting, while Endeavour 5 is far off in the North Atlantic in search of squid - but when the prey proves elusive, the pressure starts to mount.

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: S28 E11 — Royal Hospital Chelsea Remembrance Sunday special from the Royal Hospital in London, home of the Chelsea Pensioners. Michael Aspel and the team offer their opinions on a roulette table built to foil cheats, a collection of buttons worn by Charles Dickens and a gilded bee from a royal throne thought to have magical powers.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: S12 E26 — Blackpool 2 Paul Martin and the team value items at Blackpool Tower Circus. James Lewis examines an assortment of watches that have been in the back of a wardrobe for years and David Fletcher gets his hands on a pistol dating back to the Battle of Waterloo, however a collection of military medals could outshine them both. Paul looks around Lancashire's oldest family home and its antiques amassed by 14 generations.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: S10 E37 — Week 8: Tuesday Jake Bhardwaj, Sue Cleaver, Rachel Parris and Rav Wilding test their general knowledge skills in a variety of trivia-based games.

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: S24 E37 — 17/11/2026 Ellie Taylor dishes up more backstage action from the world of Strictly. Some of the couples drop by for a chat about their next performance as they prepare to battle it out in the infamous Tower Ballroom.

programme.title: Workhorse: Our Lives

programme.desc: S2 E5 — Pain Pain is a fact of life. For many, it is excruciating and inescapable, a truly disruptive force. But amid the continuing fallout of the global opioid crisis, new technologies are being developed every day to limit and potentially even eliminate pain.Professor Hannah Fry learns about the future of pain management and how revolutionary technologies are being developed to directly control pain signals. She talks to the scientists behind these technologies about how this unprecedented breakthrough works, as well as meeting pain research participants themselves in order to understand the life-changing implications of such research. Along the way, she considers how society views pain and what a pain-free future would truly mean for humanity.

Key moments include Abba in Blackpool on Seaside Special and Bay City Rollers riding the wave of Rollermania, as well as debut hits from key artists who were pioneers in their individual genres, including Bob Marley, Supertramp and Kraftwerk.

Sabrina Ghayour serves up three tasty treats that are perfect for sharing: lamb barberry and pine nut koftas, pomegranate-glazed aubergines, and muhammara dip.Rick Stein has a dish inspired by his travels, while Paul A Young makes maraschino cherry and almond truffles. Elsewhere, a rookie crew works in the Irish Sea, trainee skipper Michael steps up in a storm, and Tydus heads out in search of crabs.

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow

Items include an expensive pair of clogs, an emotional series of letters written during the Crimean War, an anti-slavery ring and an intricately woven tapestry thought to be worth £10,000. First shown in 2005.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: S12 E34 — Wiltshire 55 Paul Martin and the team value antiques in Longleat, Wiltshire, where experts Claire Rawle and Michael Baggott pick out a selection of interesting collectibles to be sold at auction, including an amethyst and pearl brooch and an autograph album featuring a set of Beatles' signatures - but their authenticity keeps the experts guessing. The presenter also uncovers the hidden architectural gems of one of Wiltshire's most famous sons, Christopher Wren, during a trip to London.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: S10 E39 — Week 8: Thursday The penultimate round of challenges for Jake Bhardwaj, Sue Cleaver, Rachel Parris and Rav Wilding. Michael Sheen asks the questions.

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: S24 E39 — 19/11/2026 Weekday fanzine devoted to the ballroom dancing show, featuring updates on the contestants and footage of rehearsals.

programme.title: The Emerald Isles
programme.desc: S1 E3 Ardal O'Hanlon starts the last leg of his journey on Garnish Island, home to lush gardens and the rare white-tailed eagle. Continuing by sea to Sherkin Island, Ardal hears about its pirate past from a historian and a resident artist reveals its current status as a painters' paradise. His final stop is Cape Clear, Ireland's southernmost island, where he is taken on a tour in one of the island's electric buses.

programme.title: Barra on the Foyle
programme.desc: Barra Best travels along the Foyle river network, criss-crossing his way across the many rivers and streams that make up its great catchment.

In Aviemore, a rock festival erupts into violence, while campers in Fort William take a wrong turn and officers are on the hunt for a suspect after a woman is attacked in an Inverness cemetery.

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
programme.desc: S1 E3 Marco Pierre White, Gordon Ramsay and Heston Blumenthal reunite for the first time in decades, revisiting the rivalries and rows that shaped their careers. Each serves an iconic dish for the others to taste as they reflect on British dining's transformation and whether wounds can heal-or competition defines them.

programme.title: Cunk on Cinema
programme.desc: S1 E2 Philomena Cunk interrogates some of the world's foremost filmmakers and critics, discovers an age of screen icons from Marilyn Monroe to Wayne John, and learns how Hollywood movies changed as American social values relaxed. She also gives her verdict on classics like Jaws, Taxi Driver, and Citizen Ken - very much the 'Citizen Kane' of films about people called Ken. Comedy, starring Diane Morgan.

programme.title: Newsnight

Back in Belfast, Jade, Tom, Perri and Adam spot an argument outside shops, where young people say their money has been stolen by a woman.

programme.title: Past Lives
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Greta Lee and Teo Yoo. Young South Korean friends Nora and Hae Sung lose touch when Nora's family moves to Canada. Years later, Nora is living in New York and gets in contact with Hae Sung over the internet. Video calls become an important part of their lives, until communication is again lost. Twelve years on, Hae Sung takes a trip to the States and the pair are reunited, but will their childhood connection still be strong.

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: S19 E6 The remaining chefs compete in the quarter-final, beginning with an invention test in which they must use saffron to embellish their dish. The cooks then serve a two-course meal for three of the country's leading food writers and critics, Leyla Kazim, Xanthe Clay and David Ellis.

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: S1 E2 — The High Notes Irish actor Chris O'Dowd joins Bill Murray and his friend Tom Coyne for a lively round of golf, with enthusiasm occasionally outstripping ability. Away from the fairways, a traditional rambling house takes Bill outside his comfort zone as he explores Ireland's rich storytelling traditions. Later, in a packed Irish pub, the music starts - and staying on the sidelines proves impossible.

Jacqui Joseph is in a Norfolk village called Little Snoring, but there's no time for her to take a nap with a property to see.

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: S27 E32 — Norfolk and Suffolk Borders Briony May Williams helps discerning house hunters from a town in Kent relocate to the quieter countryside of Norfolk and Suffolk. With three dogs and an impressive collection of cars and motorcycles, there's plenty to accommodate. So finding a home that's not too big, not too small, but just right proves quite the challenge. Briony also pulls on her waders in the River Waveney to discover what's being done to keep its waters clean for wild swimmers.

Later, their old friend Reece Shearsmith joins them for dinner, and he has some particularly spooky local tales to tell them about the Tees.

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: S2 E3 — Quantum Arms Race Through interviews with world-class experts in quantum technologies, Hannah looks at the international quantum arms race between the US and China.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: S3 E5 Colleagues from Colchester Zoo, Lizzie, Kez, Mo and Sue, compete for money by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp.

programme.desc: S1 E14 — Neath Sean Fletcher explores the annual Neath Food and Drink Festival and finds out whether traditional or gourmet Welsh cakes are more popular among the visitors. Food journalist Leyla Kazim reveals the secrets of growing tomatoes on a large or small scale farmer Jim Smith gets stuck into making marmalade and Ryan Hand tries an experiment to find out whether there is such a thing as brain food.

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: S1 E3 Investigating some of nature's biggest mysteries.

programme.desc: E1 — Winter Specials 2026/27 Monty Don celebrates the rewards of winter gardening, sharing ideas, inspiration and timely jobs to keep gardeners busy now, while reminding viewers that warmer days lie ahead. At Longmeadow, he has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses, while Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment, where there is always plenty to do during the colder months, including some clever composting.

programme.title: World Championship Boxing
programme.desc: Lauren Price v Michaela Kotaskova Lauren Price v Michaela Kotaskova. Catrin Heledd presents live coverage of the bout for the IBF, IBO and WBC World Welterweight titles, held at Utilita Arena Cardiff. Home favourite Price won Olympic gold in 2020 and is undefeated in her 10 professional contests, outpointing Stephanie Pineiro last time out. Her Czech opponent has a respectable record of 12 wins, two draws and just one defeat, but it would be a major upset should she take Price's belts this evening.

programme.title: The Dead Don't Hurt
programme.desc: Western starring Vicky Krieps and Viggo Mortensen. In 1860s America, French-Canadian Vivienne and Danish immigrant Holger decide to make a life together in the wilds of Nevada. However, the Civil War takes Holger away, leaving Vivienne to deal with the corrupt local landowner and his violent, sadistic son.

programme.title: Match of the Day Wales Live
programme.desc: Norway v Wales 14.11 Norway v Wales (Kick-off 5.00pm). All the action from both teams' fifth and penultimate UEFA Nations League Group A4 match, held at Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo. Both teams have just one win and three defeats to their name in the group, with Wales' victory coming in last month's reverse fixture at Cardiff City Stadium. Oscar Bobb opened the scoring for the Norwegians on that occasion, but Craig Bellamy's men fought back with strikes from Dan James and Neco Williams.

programme.title: Live International Football ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: Northern Ireland v Ukraine Northern Ireland v Ukraine (Kick-off 7.45pm). All the action from both teams' penultimate UEFA Nations League Group B2 match, held at Windsor Park. Northern Ireland went into this round of fixtures on top of the table with two wins and two draws, with their most convincing display coming against the Ukrainians in Slovakia. They prevailed 3-0 in that contest thanks to a brace by Ciaron Brown and a strike from Isaac Price, and another victory would secure them a place in at least the promotion play-offs.

programme.title: 40 Hits of 1975 at the BBC
programme.desc: Take a musical trip back in time to 50 years ago, with 40 essential hits from 1975 plucked from the BBC's archives. The punk explosion was two years away and disco was only just starting to surface, but these 12 months were still packed with classic songs that remain staples to this day. Key moments include Abba in Blackpool on Seaside Special and Bay City Rollers riding the wave of Rollermania, as well as debut hits from key artists who were pioneers in their individual genres, including Bob Marley, Supertramp and Kraftwerk.

programme.title: Godland
programme.desc: Period drama starring Elliott Crosset Hove and Ingvar Sigurdsson. In the late 19th century, Danish Lutheran missionary Lucas is sent to a remote community in Iceland, where he is to build and establish a church. With the reluctant help of his gruff guide, Ragnar, Lucas weathers the challenges of the harsh rural climate, but the demands of his mission begin to take their toll.

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: S2 E6 The tragic events of the party send shockwaves through the Phelans. As dangerous secrets threaten to come to light, Michael is forced to make a difficult confession to Diana. Meanwhile, unseen dangers close in, and it becomes clear no-one is safe.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: S4 E2 Sam Ryder, Jeff Stelling and Ella Eyre, accompanied by friends or relatives, and Princess and Junior Andre continue their epic 7,500km race. The second leg takes the teams across the heart of Borneo to a modern metropolis on its eastern coast and their second checkpoint.

programme.title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
programme.desc: S2 E2 — Ade Adepitan Anita strikes up an in-depth conversation with Paralympian and broadcaster Ade Adepitan, discovering what makes Christmas special for him and how it's been a marker for memorable moments in his career, family life and faith.

programme.desc: S2026 — Co Antrim Dairy Charlotte Smith and Adam Henson explore how dairy farmers across Co Antrim, one of Northern Ireland's most productive dairy regions, are turning to tech and innovative business models to build a more resilient future. Adam also introduces this year's BBC Food and Farming Awards Countryfile Young Countryside Champion nominees.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: S2026 E22 Dougie Vipond visits Castlemilk on the southern edge of Glasgow to explores a local nature reserve that has transformed the location from perceived no-go zone to a thriving green place. Arlene Stuart heads to an Aberdeenshire shoemakers' workshop that shut over 80 years ago to meet the locals carefully conserving the shop's contents, while Anne Lundon is on the Black Isle finding out about a charity funded by Children in Need providing bereavement support across the Highlands.

programme.title: Sian Eleri's BBC Children in Need Road Trip
programme.desc: Radio 1 presenter Sian Eleri takes on an almighty challenge when BBC Children In Need's Pudsey bear sends her on a Wales-wide road trip. Her mission is to find six Children In Need funded projects across Wales that support the development and well-being of young people.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: S2025 — 30/11/2025 Andi Oliver takes a classic British dessert and transforms it into a savoury number with her three cheese and leek bread and butter pudding. She then grills slices of it with a rarebit sauce on top, serving it with a leek and spinach veloute. Niklas Ekstedt brings the taste of Sweden to the studio with the iconic Jansson's temptation, which he serves alongside a deliciously fatty pork chop. Sabrina Ghayour serves up three tasty treats that are perfect for sharing: lamb barberry and pine nut koftas, pomegranate-glazed aubergines, and muhammara dip.Rick Stein has a dish inspired by his travels, while Paul A Young makes maraschino cherry and almond truffles. And Mel C is in the hot seat to face either her food heaven, roast lamb, or her food hell, okra.Meanwhile, Rick Stein has a peek behind the scenes at how the filming of his shows doesn't always go to plan, and Clive Myrie gets a taste of Caribbean honey.

programme.title: Best Bakes Ever
programme.desc: S1 E10 In light of Britain's baking obsession, actress and cake expert Jane Asher presents a selection of recipes from television chefs, including James Martin, Mary Berry, Paul Hollywood, the Hairy Bikers, Raymond Blanc, Nigella Lawson, Tom Kerridge, Lorraine Pascale and Rachel Khoo.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Unsung Heroes (Shortened Version) The food writer prepares simple, tasty meals from ingredients that are often overlooked, including a lentil and chard stew.

programme.title: Jane Eyre
programme.desc: Period drama based on Charlotte Brontë's classic novel, starring Orson Welles and Joan Fontaine. Following an austere orphanage upbringing, a shy young woman becomes a governess in a vast Yorkshire mansion where the master of the house, Rochester, appears troubled by some inner torment.

programme.title: Spellbound
programme.desc: Psychological thriller starring Ingrid Bergman and Gregory Peck. Dedicated psychiatrist Constance Peterson amazes everyone, including herself, by falling in love with a man she believes to be a paranoid impostor and who may even be guilty of murder.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: S14 E51 — Compilation 57 A collection of interesting finds from the show, with visits to Margam Country Park in south Wales, Highcliffe Castle in Dorset and Powderham Castle in Devon. Experts including Catherine Southon, Adam Partridge, Philip Serrell, Will Axon, Christina Trevanion and Mark Stacey assess items ranging from a South African Krugerrand coin to a rare walnut-shaped Japanese flintlock. Presenter Paul Martin also takes a look at the treasures and lavish interiors at Firle Place in East Sussex.

programme.title: Golf: Tour Championship Highlights
programme.desc: 2026 Action from the DP World Tour season-ending event, which came from Jumeirah Golf Estates in Dubai the United Arab Emirates. England's Matt Fitzpatrick won this tournament for a record-equalling third time last year, beating 2024 champion Rory McIlroy of Northern Ireland, who has also claimed this title on three occasions, in a play-off.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: S4 E3 Sam Ryder, Jeff Stelling, Ella Eyre and Princess and Junior Andre continue their 7,500km race. The third leg sees the teams leave behind the ancient jungles of Borneo to reach the island of Sulawesi, an Indonesian wonderland that lies far from the tourist trail. But with the end of Ramadan fast approaching, the teams must negotiate the crowds heading home for Eid al-Fitr.

programme.desc: S6 E8 As the days grow longer, the MacDonalds round up their pregnant Highland cattle on the tiny island of Vallay, off North Uist, for a pre-natal check up and vitamin boost. In the Cairngorms, Jenni's new alpaca arena is finally finished, which means her menagerie of alpacas, donkeys and goats must be moved to their new home. Nikki and Ollie speculate to accumulate in Moray, splashing out on a new honesty shack.

Simon arrives by ferry in Co Wexford and travels along the coast, joining the thousands who try to climb the sacred mountain of Croagh Patrick. He crosses the border to visit Crom Castle and Londonderry, before journeying to the northernmost point at Malin Head.

Then friends and familiar faces gather to celebrate a milestone birthday - and a Bill reflects on what the future holds.

programme.desc: Oscar-winning thriller starring Jeremy Renner. A US Army bomb-disposal team working out the last 38 days of their tour in Iraq are joined by Staff Sgt William James, whose unorthodox methods make him initially unpopular with his colleagues.

Released on bail while police await DNA results, the man is soon wanted over another violent attack. On the Isle of Skye, rescuers race to find a climber missing for three days in the mountains, while an American tourist has an unusual concern after a crash near Fort William.

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: 12/11/2026 Fiona Bruce hosts the topical debate, with a panel of politicians and other guests facing questions from the audience in Exeter.

In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: S3 E5 Colleagues from Colchester Zoo, Lizzie, Kez, Mo and Sue, compete for money by crossing a bridge of stepping stones across the studio floor. Quiz show, hosted by Ross Kemp.

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: S1 E14 — Neath Sean Fletcher explores the annual Neath Food and Drink Festival and finds out whether traditional or gourmet Welsh cakes are more popular among the visitors. Food journalist Leyla Kazim reveals the secrets of growing tomatoes on a large or small scale farmer Jim Smith gets stuck into making marmalade and Ryan Hand tries an experiment to find out whether there is such a thing as brain food.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Thurso to Orkney From Britain's northernmost station at Thurso in Caithness, Michael Portillo heads for the ferry port of Scrabster to cross the Pentland Firth to the Orkney Islands. Passing the Old Man of Hoy, Michael takes in stunning views of the Orkney archipelago and the rugged coastlines of its 70 islands.

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: S1 E5 — The Gamble Adam Cowan Dickie takes a gamble and leaves the English Channel in the hope of finding Dover sole, one of the most expensive fish in British waters, to help cover his rising financial issues. Up in Scotland, Stephen West breaks from the rest of the fleet for some solo fishing, but heads towards some stormy weather, leaving him with a decision to make.

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: S28 E15 — Coughton Court 1 Michael Aspel and the team look at more rarities, this time from Coughton Court in Warwickshire. Among the finds are a Japanese depiction of dancing skeletons, a design from a leading British graphic artist and a previously lost masterpiece. First shown in 2005.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: S12 E23 — Somerset 11 Charlie Ross and Thomas Plant value antiques at the Fleet Air Arm Museum in Yeovilton, Somerset, while Paul Martin finds out about one of Europe's largest helicopter squadrons.

programme.title: House of Games
programme.desc: S10 E40 — Week 8: Friday Michael Sheen asks the questions on Double Points Friday. Jake Bhardwaj, Sue Cleaver, Rachel Parris and Rav Wilding hope they have what it takes to win the day's challenges, and be the week's overall victor.

programme.title: Strictly: It Takes Two
programme.desc: S24 E40 — 20/11/2026 Analysis of the couples' progress as they prepare for tomorrow night's show. Including reports from the studio rehearsals and interviews with celebrity fans.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: 20/11/2026 Analysis of the day's events with Matt Chorley.

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: S1 E3 Investigating some of nature's biggest mysteries.

programme.title: Gardeners' World Winter Specials
programme.desc: E1 — Winter Specials 2026/27 Monty Don celebrates the rewards of winter gardening, sharing ideas, inspiration and timely jobs to keep gardeners busy now, while reminding viewers that warmer days lie ahead. At Longmeadow, he has hellebores to plant, peas to sow and practical advice on propagating roses, while Sue Kent gets to work on her allotment, where there is always plenty to do during the colder months, including some clever composting.

programme.title: World Championship Boxing
programme.desc: Lauren Price v Michaela Kotaskova Lauren Price v Michaela Kotaskova. Catrin Heledd presents live coverage of the bout for the IBF, IBO and WBC World Welterweight titles, held at Utilita Arena Cardiff. Home favourite Price won Olympic gold in 2020 and is undefeated in her 10 professional contests, outpointing Stephanie Pineiro last time out. Her Czech opponent has a respectable record of 12 wins, two draws and just one defeat, but it would be a major upset should she take Price's belts this evening.

programme.title: The Dead Don't Hurt
programme.desc: Western starring Vicky Krieps and Viggo Mortensen. In 1860s America, French-Canadian Vivienne and Danish immigrant Holger decide to make a life together in the wilds of Nevada. However, the Civil War takes Holger away, leaving Vivienne to deal with the corrupt local landowner and his violent, sadistic son.

programme.title: Wild
programme.desc: Water Voles Documentary presenting an intimate portrait of one of Britain's most charming wild animals, following a family of water voles living on a canal in Derbyshire through a typical year.

programme.title: Full Circle with Michael Palin

programme.title: Smerconish
programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.desc: S3 E1 — Murder Bites Homicide Hunter follows Lieutenant Joe Kenda as he retells the stories of his most challenging and disturbing murder cases.

programme.title: Fugitives Caught on Tape
programme.desc: S2 E6 — Episode 6 Law enforcement officers pursue fugitives on the run. A man who tried to run his daughter over with a pickup truck shoots at officers and rams a police cruiser; a state trooper captures a fugitive.

programme.title: My Strange Arrest
programme.desc: S3 — Top 5: Strange Chases A look at some of the strangest police chases from across the country. A man steals a front loader and evades police. A mother flees from the police holding a baby. And officers chase a man in a stolen mail truck.

programme.title: My Strange Arrest
programme.desc: S3 — Top 5: Strange Steals A look at some of the strangest thefts from across the country: a man steals a snake by stuffing it down his pants, a woman turns shoplifting into a game of chance, a man makes himself a pizza while breaking into a pizzeria, and much more!

programme.title: Court Cam
programme.desc: S8 E34 — Episode 34 A defendant drops the F-bomb in court when he's not happy with the ruling; the judge doesn't hold back when sentencing a man pleading guilty to battery; a judge mutes the microphone of a defendant who won't stop interrupting her; and more.

programme.title: Cops Who Kill With Will Mellor
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Stephanie Lazarus Will Mellor and a panel of experts uncover the case of former LA detective Stephanie Lazarus, who was convicted of murdering her ex-boyfriend's wife in 1986.

programme.title: Cops Who Kill With Will Mellor
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Steven Jones Will Mellor and a team of experts delve into the case of Steven Jones, who tried to use his police knowledge to get away with the murder of his wife Madallin.

programme.title: Cops Who Kill With Will Mellor
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Roger Rogerson Will Mellor and a team of experts explore the case of ex-cop Roger Rogerson, who was handed a life sentence in 2016 for the murder of student Jamie Gao.

programme.title: Green Eyed Killers
programme.desc: S3 E12 — Hollie Gazzard Just days after Hollie Gazzard had attempted to end her relationship with Asher Maslin, her life was cut tragically short as the jealous ex attacked.

programme.title: Accident, Suicide, or Murder
programme.desc: S4 E15 — A Loaded Crime Scene A husband shoots his wife across the kitchen table whilst cleaning a gun. He claims it was an accident, but when her colleague mysteriously dies a few days later, investigators have a closer look at the case.

programme.title: Accident, Suicide, or Murder
programme.desc: S4 E19 — Cutting Ties On the edge of divorce, a couple's argument over custody turns deadly. The husband claims he killed his wife in self-defence when she attacked him with scissors, but a look into his past holds a deadly secret.

programme.title: Accident, Suicide, or Murder
programme.desc: S4 E2 — Father Knows Death Two unusual accidents that are two decades apart leave a family suspicious of a father who appears to benefit from tragedy.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter
programme.desc: S7 E7 — After School Special Beloved teacher Barbara Lewis is poisoned in her classroom, as doctors fight to save her life, Lt. Joe Kenda and his team delve into her personal affairs looking for clues, but the biggest revelation comes from the poison itself.

programme.title: The First 48

programme.title: Court Cam

programme.title: Court Cam
programme.desc: S8 E10 — Episode 10 A convicted cop killer tells the court that he deserves the death penalty; a judge dismisses the jury after a witness' testimony becomes too emotional; a man charged with DWI gets caught lying to the judge; and more.

programme.title: My Strange Arrest ᴺᵉʷ

programme.title: My Strange Arrest ᴺᵉʷ

programme.desc: S3 E108 — Bournemouth In Bournemouth, David and AJ plan a South African menu, with bread in every course. Vinnie and Alex serve South American dishes. And, Andrea and Wayne's Vietnamese night doesn't go to plan.

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: S9 E5 — The One with Joe Swash Indecisive groom Dele has £12,000 and just 3 weeks to put on a wedding to impress bride-to-be Tracy, but after a 15-year engagement Tracy wants nothing less than her dream of a romantic wedding in a castle.

programme.title: Don't Tell the Bride
programme.desc: S9 E6 — The One in the Batcave Comic book loving groom Anthony has just three weeks and £12,000 to plan a wedding for his bride-to-be Lauren. While Anthony wants to prove he can be a real superhero to Lauren with a comic inspired wedding in a cave, she is dreaming of a more traditional affair.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: S11 E23 — Crickets and Wickets Rene brings Gunther along to West Covina, California for moral support, but gets annoyed when the older German will not take sides. Darrell stumbles over a potential diamond in the rough, and Brandi and Jarrod discover a different national pastime.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: S11 E24 — Quality Bro Chime During 'Bring Your Brother to Work Day' in Thousand Oaks, California, Justin sinks his money into a unit with an interesting pair. Dave pushes Mary to the breaking point, and Kenny makes a nice profit piece by piece.

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: S6 E4 — Maaco When Maaco President Jose Costa goes undercover, he gets overheated after finding an employee is cutting corners.

programme.title: Undercover Boss USA
programme.desc: S6 E5 — Phenix Salon Suites Phenix Salon Inc founder Gina Rivera must complete a pedicure and a straight-razor shave while undercover.

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos
programme.desc: S33 E2 — Bird Brains, Windy City, and Didn't Go the Way You Thought It Would Birds causing trouble; wind wreaks havoc on people; a boy gives his mum tips on how to flirt.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: S13 E4 — Mirro, Mirro, on the Floor In Santa Ana, Dan and Laura hope for better units and better buyers. Rene tries to capitalise on warehouse sales and scoots away with a deal. Jarrod finally buys the locker he wants; Darrell reflects on what it means to buy lockers full of antiques.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: S13 E5 — Rules #1 Ivy brings his son to Moreno Valley, where good things always happen, and leaves with yo-yo's of an unexpected kind. Rene and Casey discover that their shoes are more 'air' and less 'Jordan'.

programme.title: Below Deck Down Under
programme.desc: S3 E15 — Smoochies Bri starts to worry about her relationship off the yacht. Alesia gets a sudden "ick" from baby talk. Marina puts her walls down, but worries feelings aren't reciprocated. Tzarina and Lara come to a stalemate with neither of them ready to apologise.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: S5 E6 — Revisited No. 1 Gordon Ramsay revisits Café Hon in Hampden, Maryland, Chiarella's in Philadelphia, and Leone's in Montclair, New Jersey, to see whether the restaurant owners have taken his advice on board.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: S5 E7 — Olde Hitching Post Gordon heads to the historic Olde Hitching Post in Hanson, Massachusetts, where he meets an owner so stubborn and set in his ways that he doesn't realise he's the reason his restaurant is losing money. Owner Tom bought the business for his daughter Andrea, but six years later he is still refusing to let her run it. Gordon must fight a controlling boss who doesn't react well to his criticism.

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: S16 E7 — Episode 7 Jimmy Carr hosts the game show mash-up as Sean Lock and Kevin Bridges take on Joe Wilkinson and Victoria Coren Mitchell. Adam Kay joins Susie Dent in Dictionary Corner, while maths whizz Rachel Riley looks after the numbers.

programme.title: 8 Out of 10 Cats Does Countdown
programme.desc: S16 E8 — Episode 8 Jimmy Carr hosts the final as Sean Lock and Roisin Conaty take on guest captain Alan Carr and Joe Lycett. Plus guest Spencer Jones in Dictionary Corner while maths whizz Rachel Riley looks after the numbers and letters.

programme.desc: S11 E4 — Premature Conker Charlotte Ritchie climbs a ladder with some loo roll, Mike Wozniak tries out a new catchphrase, and Lee Mack terrifies an innocent member of the public.

programme.desc: S9 E9 — You Got Me Mean Tammy Gardner loves being a mum and running a daycare out of her suburban Delaware home. She also loves a night out on the town. What starts as innocent fun leads this 40-year-old down a dark path of jealousy and deadly rage.

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: S9 E10 — Gone Hunting Police officer Albert Pacheco and his wife Cathy live Hawaii's Big Island, raising four kids in the bosom of their close-knit church community. What looks like a household steeped in traditional goodness is hiding something evil.

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: S10 E1 — Friends Outside of Work Young parents Gary and Tasha Bentley are living the good life. They've got high-paying jobs, a nice house, and regular holidays to the tropics, but just five years into their marriage, someone's plotting an exit strategy that ends with a bullet.

programme.title: Who Hired the Hitman?
programme.desc: S1 E5 — The Genius and the Mastermind The assassination of a computer genius sends detectives on a two-decade hunt for missing gold, uncovers a shocking link to a Saudi sheik, and exposes a deadly international scheme that claims another life.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates
programme.desc: S9 E12 — Where is Judith? A home intruder abducts a 60-year-old woman in the night. Local sheriffs search relentlessly until they discover another horrifying attack just ten miles away that fits the same profile. Is there a serial predator haunting Florida's Gulf Coast?

programme.title: The Green River Killer: Mind of a Monster
programme.desc: With exclusive interviews and access to hundreds of hours of unseen police footage, the shocking truth behind one of America's most prolific serial killers is revealed.

programme.title: Faking It: Tears of a Crime
programme.desc: S4 E1 — The Grenfell Conman A man says he survived the Grenfell fire and that his wife and son were among the victims. After he claims £12,500 and appears on TV, police become suspicious.

programme.title: Faking It: Tears of a Crime
programme.desc: S4 E2 — The White House Farm Murderer In 1985, Jeremy Bamber shot his parents, his sister and her twin sons but has protested his innocence ever since in messages sent from prison.

programme.title: On the Case With Paula Zahn

programme.title: On the Case With Paula Zahn
programme.desc: S26 E7 — A Quest for Justice A young mother is murdered inside her home, and her family hopes to help put her killer behind bars.

programme.title: Feuds Turned Fatal

programme.title: Feuds Turned Fatal

programme.desc: England v Japan England v Japan (Kick-off 4.40pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Allianz Stadium Twickenham. England have won all six of the previous meetings between the nations, including a comfortable 59-14 victory here when the sides last faced each other two years ago, and they will expect to maintain that 100 per cent record today. With commentary by Nick Mullins and David Flatman, analysis from Ugo Monye and Maggie Alphonsi, and reports by Topsy Ojo.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: S1 E29 — Ireland v Fiji Ireland v Fiji (Kick-off 8.10pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Aviva Stadium. Ireland boast a 100 per cent record from their eight meetings with Fiji, and comfortably prevailed 52-17 in the most recent of those encounters two years ago, which also took place at this venue. With the Fijians failing to win any of their opening three contests, the Irish will be expecting yet another victory this evening. With commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy, analysis from Ugo Monye and Maggie Alphonsi, and reports by Claire Thomas.

programme.title: Grantchester
programme.desc: S9 E2 Geordie receives a call about a dead body at the River View Hotel but when he goes to investigate, Will and Bonnie discover a baby abandoned inside the church wrapped in a blanket from the same hotel. Ernie leads the pair to believe the baby was abandoned by a school girl. Geordie is shocked and upset to hear Will and Bonnie are thinking of leaving Grantchester.

programme.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas
programme.desc: S1 E2 — From Farm to Table Ainsley Harriott explores the Bahamas' home-grown side as he finds out how to grow salad vegetables without soil at Blue Fields, picks ingredients straight from the trees at Chiccharney Farms and discovers the magic of the mangroves. Once back in his beachside kitchen, Ainsley proceeds to cook a whole snapper.

programme.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Sweet Island Life Ainsley Harriott explores the country's sweet treats, sampling honey, sugarcane and guava duff. He also meets the makers keeping old-school confectionery alive at Mortimer's Candies, and creates coconut lime creams with a crunchy Bahamian twist.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S5 E6 Agronomist Ben Clare arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, while Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual date with a visit to local beekeepers. There is also a farewell as bull Ezra's time on the farm comes to an end and Kelvin takes him to market in the hope of finding him a new home.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Orkney James goes on a culinary road trip around the UK and kicks off his travels in the Orkneys, where he is joined by fellow chef Nick Nairn. He shops for hand-dived scallops, before setting up his mobile kitchen in Stromness harbour to make barbecue scallops with black pudding, apple and hazelnut butter. He also meets the owner of a unique herd of sheep in the remote island of North Ronaldsay.

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: S9 E35 James is joined by actress Shelley Conn, who is starring in ITV1's Adultery. The comedian and travel writer Dom Joly is also in the house, with chefs Sally Abe and Glynn Purnell. James cooks Thai green curry and Spanish tapas.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm

First-time nerves are running high, but preparations take a worrying turn when Kelvin spots maggots in Hope's fleece.
